numerical_discretion.authored_numeric_mechanic_rule: Define the mechanic before resolution. Do not choose a result after seeing the desired outcome.

business_card_schema.name: <Business Name>
business_card_schema.revenue_base: <number >= 0; required only when revenue_mode is rolled>
business_card_schema.fixed_revenue: <number >= 0; required only when revenue_mode is fixed>
business_card_schema.facility_value: <number >= 0; required for rolled Businesses; the facility value repair costs are later derived from; the planner preserves it and performs no repair arithmetic; a fixed Business rejects the key by presence (including an explicit null) and omits it from the normalized plan>
business_card_schema.funds_enabled: <boolean; whether Business fund accounting applies (distinct from current active state)>
internal_sources: <business id whose same-day realized sales/revenue is this Business's raw-material cost>

rules: This template creates no company, money, workforce, assets, reputation or income in RHC canon.
Create a separately named configuration file before activating an economy mechanic.
Populate only DM-approved values and mechanics.

Mutable financial/resource state belongs in state/live_status.json#businesses (active/disabled state, current fund balances, current stock and Business-owned duration effects) or a future explicitly authorized dedicated state file.
Random results must be resolved by the campaign's approved RNG procedure rather than selected for a preferred outcome.
Business Cards are authoring declarations only. POST-EV2-12.1 plans and validates them; it never rolls dice, resolves money, applies Reputation, or persists state.
Every Business that resolves operating economics declares an explicit revenue base (or fixed revenue) and a fixed daily cost.

A rolled Business declares an explicit finite non-negative facility_value in its declared currency: the repair-cost basis the later resolver multiplies by the selected repair percentage. The planner validates and preserves it exactly and never multiplies it; fixed Businesses carry no repair mechanic and declare no facility_value, rejecting the key by presence (including an explicit null) and omitting it from the normalized plan.
Whether a Business resolves today (active/disabled) is current state; funds_enabled is a separate configuration/policy fact. They are never the same fact.
A Business whose current state says active:false resolves nothing that day and produces no daily dice requests, regardless of its funds_enabled value.

A fund_policy is required whenever any Business declares funds_enabled:true, and it is retained in the normalized plan. The superseded negotiated supplier_agreements / suppliers pricing surfaces fail closed; internal_sources is the same-day source-cost authority.

The approved default positive-net allocation is 20% HQ / 70% Business Development / 10% Business Recovery; deficits and repair obligations cover own Recovery -> HQ Recovery -> uncovered loss, and the Development Fund is never auto-drawn.

Internal raw-material cost for an explicitly linked source Business equals that source Business's actual realized same-day sales/revenue. Negotiated buyer-specific supplier pricing is not the approved internal cost mechanic.
The business_units map and internal_sources links are inert until a named configuration is explicitly instantiated for RHC.
